about.title: Preparing taxes in Pasadena since 2005.
text: Garcia's Notary began its tax preparation work in 2005. Over the years the office has built up insight and experience in tax preparation, enriched by academic courses and continuous learning.

The client base has grown to include many individuals, and the office keeps expanding its services to meet clients' needs. The approach is personal and attentive: you are a cherished customer, a familiar presence, a valued friend and a trusted neighbor, and when you reach out the office is there to help.

facts.heading: MyTaxOffice Mobile App
facts.text: Start your return in the MyTaxOffice app, on Google Play and the App Store: upload your personal information, W-2s and documents securely within minutes. After installing the app, enter the firm passcode 216G8M.
